photos.title: Surfside Beach pier and oceanfront from above
photos.what: The Surfside Beach pier and oceanfront from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the pier running into the surf, the sand beach, rows of beach houses along the shore and streets of houses and trees behind.
photos.caption: The Surfside Beach pier and oceanfront from the air: the pier, the sand and rows of beach houses, with streets of houses and trees behind.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Surfside Beach oceanfront: a pier running out into the surf, a wide sand beach, rows of beach houses along the shore and tree-covered streets of houses behind
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023 (the image service's primary mosaic at the frame), natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.
